name: Musical chairs
summary: Musical chairs in the chat: drawn chairs in a circle, everyone still in walks around them while the music plays, the music cuts at a random moment, tap a chair to sit; whoever is left standing is out and the last one sitting wins a prize like picking the movie.
useWhen: nobody can pick the movie tonight, make it a game
everyone's home and bored, quick game for the gc
winner picks dinner, loser does dishes
musical chairs but over text lol
settle who gets the aux with a two minute game
dontUseWhen: a plain vote on what to watch (use a poll or movie-bracket)
a game with questions or words (use trivia-night or word-bomb)
fewer than three people in the chat

prize.description: What the winner gets, said after their name: 'picks the movie'

out.description: People already out, in order, with what they said in their own words

early.description: False starts so far: who tapped before the music stopped, and how many times
